Hi Alice -

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement readiness and the security gating items you flagged.

Call recap (high level):
- Primary use case: customer support automation (embedding-based search + generation) for Acme's Knowledge Base.
- Expected pilot: ~50k messages/month, latency SLO ~200ms P95 for responses.
- Security/compliance blockers: SOC 2 Type II evidence, a signed DPA, and completion of the standard SaaS security questionnaire.
- Commercial path: Procurement team prefers PO for enterprise contracts; they asked about Marketplace options if we have an Oracle/AWS listing (you mentioned that as a possibility).

Action items I have captured:
1) Marissa (me) share SOC 2 summary + draft DPA - attached.
2) Dev to confirm technical controls and answer any questionnaire specifics (cc'd).
3) Acme to confirm preferred procurement flow (PO vs card) and target approval timeline.

Attachments included in this email: SOC2-TypeII-summary-stub.pdf (summary), Redwood-DPA-draft.docx (redlineable).

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- If Acme can sign DPA and accept standard T&Cs, we can enable a sandbox org within 3 business days.
- For a PO-based purchase, typical commercial cycle is ~3-4 weeks (review + PO issuance); if you prefer card, we can onboard sooner.

Questions for you now:
- Confirm procurement path (PO or card)? If PO, please share the PO contact and billing details.
- Would receiving a filled security questionnaire from our Security team accelerate review? We can complete the XLS and return it within 48 hours.

Happy to hop on a quick follow-up with procurement and Tom from IT if that helps.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Hi Marissa -

Appreciate the detailed recap. A few answers and clarifications from Procurement/IT:

1) Procurement path: Acme prefers a PO for anything over $50k per year. For a short pilot under $10k we may be able to use a corporate card, but the preferred path for pilot->production is PO.
2) PO contact: procurement@acme.com (cc'd on this thread). Billing address and PO template: see attached internal guidance (I will email the template separately if needed).
3) Security: We need SOC 2 Type II evidence (not just a summary). Can you provide either a redacted report or a letter of attestation? Also, would prefer the DPA via DocuSign if you have a template link.
4) Timeline: We are aiming to make a decision before the end of our quarter (target date 2027-01-15). Procurement review typically takes 2-3 weeks once SOC2/DPA are in place.

Yes, please have your Security team fill our standard questionnaire. If you can return that within 48 hours it will help speed the review. Also please confirm who will be signing the DPA on Redwood's side (name/title).

Thanks,
Alice
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
alice.gomez@acme.com

Thanks, Alice - clear and helpful.

Quick notes:

- DPA: we use DocuSign for final signatures. Link to our standard DPA template: https://www.docusign.com/templates/redwood-dpa-template (also attached as a Word doc you can redline). Our legal lead (Neha Kapoor, VP Legal) typically signs DPAs on behalf of Redwood.
- PO vs card: understood - we will treat this as PO-based commercial path. If anything is under $10k and you want to test earlier we can accept card for the pilot.

I've asked Neha to have Security/Legal complete the questionnaire you shared. Dev will answer any technical control questions on the XLS.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
- 12/10: Redwood returns completed security questionnaire + DPA (redlineable).
- 12/11-12/15: Acme legal/procurement review.
- 12/18: If approvals in place, Redwood enables sandbox org and issues invoice or payment link depending on procurement path.

If that timeline works I'll route the DPA to Neha today and get the questionnaire filled by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa
